_comment: Bench sweep configuration. Copy and edit per run (python run_sweep.py --config my.json). Numbers marked TODO must be measured on your bench; the harness never assumes them.
label: heltec-v4-sx1262

pluto._ref_note: Pluto output power at hardwaregain 0 dB, measured with a power meter or a trusted analyser (per frequency if possible). null = report relative dB only, no dBm.

rtl._range_note: typical R820T/R828D tuner range; set the range your dongle actually tunes
rtl._path_note: swap = move the cable from DUT to RTL when prompted; splitter = both connected through a splitter (enter its loss below)
rtl._check_gain_note: Pluto gain used for the RTL source check: high enough that spurs at spur_dbc_max sit above the RTL floor, never above pluto.max_gain_db

path._note: total loss Pluto->DUT = fixed + filter insertion loss + cable + splitter + step. Keep filter_loss_db null until measured: MDS input dBm MUST remain unknown.

meta.fem_mode: automatic per-frequency RX LNA/bypass; verify live
meta._fem_note: V4 boards put an external FEM (GC1109 or KCT8103L by revision, per third-party docs) in front of the SX1262; record which part and whether RX runs in LNA or bypass mode, as it changes gain, noise figure, band limits and the safe input level
